title: The three-card tarot spread
description: How the three-card tarot spread works: past, present, next and situation, action, outcome, with a method for reading the story across the cards.

scenes.headline: The three-card tarot spread
scenes.caption: The three-card tarot spread is a flexible layout that can tell a story over time or frame a choice. Here are two ways to read it.
scenes.vo: The three-card tarot spread is a flexible layout that can tell a story over time or frame a choice. Here are two ways to read it.

scenes.headline: The classic frame: past, present, next
scenes.caption: The most familiar version reads left to right. Card 1 is the past, card 2 is the present and card 3 is what comes next.
scenes.vo: The classic frame: past, present, next. The most familiar version reads left to right. Card 1 is the past, card 2 is the present and card 3 is what comes next.

scenes.headline: A second frame: situation, action, outcome
scenes.caption: The same three places can ask different questions.
scenes.vo: A second frame: situation, action, outcome. The same three places can ask different questions.
